CVE-2026-109976.title: clevis: clevis: integer underflow in PKCS#11 data socket handler crashes daemon on unbound client connection
CVE-2026-109976.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon crashes when an AF_UNIX client connects to the data socket without a bound address, due to an integer underflow in the getpeername result handling. This causes a denial of service, preventing LUKS disk decryption from completing during boot.
